title: "Clear All Notifications" should animate the notifications disappearing before the popup closes so that it's clear something happened
line: Clear All Notifications now slides the notifications away one after the other before the popup closes.
explanation: The Clear All action cleared the history and the popup closed as soon as the list became empty, so the notifications just vanished together with the popup and it looked like nothing had been cleared. When every notification is going to be cleared and the popup is open, the action now first slides and fades the notifications out in a short top-to-bottom wave (twice the long animation duration), then clears the history, which closes the popup as before. If some notifications stay (still active ones), the clear happens right away as before.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: animate notifications away on Clear All

Clearing all notifications closed the popup right away, so it wasn't
clear that anything had happened. When everything is going to be
cleared, the notifications now slide out from the top before closing.

BUG: 445926
